🇨🇩🇺🇸 What was a former UFC fighter doing in the middle of Congo’s war?

Tim Kennedy isn’t just a former UFC fighter. He’s also a retired U.S. Green Beret, and he was working with Erik Prince’s private security company, Vectus Global.

Congo hired Prince’s team to help government forces hold strategic towns and secure valuable mining areas as they fight the Rwanda-backed M23 rebellion in the east.

In mid-September, Kennedy was with a Vectus team in South Kivu when they were ambushed.

About 20 people were reportedly killed or wounded, including at least seven Congolese soldiers and a former New Zealand special forces member. Kennedy was shot three times in the leg.

Sources said the attack appeared too precise for ordinary local rebels and suspected Rwandan forces were involved.

So this wasn’t a former UFC fighter randomly turning up in Congo. Kennedy was part of a private military operation supporting the Congolese government in its war in the east.
